title: 9 Dead After Accidental Blast at Police Station in Kashmir
summary: The explosion in the city of Srinagar happened as Indian officials were inspecting bomb-making material seized in an investigation into a terror network allegedly involving doctors.

title: China issues travel warning for Japan over threats to intervene in Taiwan

title: Charting the Global Economy: Disparity Tests a Resilient Europe
summary: Euro-area economic growth picked up slightly in the third quarter, yet activity in nearly half the bloc is stagnating at best and tempering optimism of a broader recovery.
